notes: «- المعنى -» is an editor's gloss, left out; the two shaykhs are one co-transmitting level
«فبلغ ذلك امرأة ... فقالت» : Umm Ya'qub speaks in the scene but does not transmit, so she is not a link
«قال محمد والواصلات وقال عثمان والمتنمصات» are wording variants of the two transmitters, left out
the chain ends at عبد الله, whose words the report relays
